rent.statusesSeparate: These four statuses are separate. A calculated split is not a completed remittance.
rent.reviewTerms: Review the terms in both languages before signing

policy.turnoverVsTax: Business turnover recorded here is not government tax revenue.
policy.permitVsTax: Council permit fees are separate from TRA tax and are not collected as tax.
policy.expenseEvidence: Expenses are labelled by the quality of evidence held. IBMT does not decide deductibility.
policy.recordNotFiscal: Business record — not a fiscal EFD/VFD receipt.
policy.fiscalConfirmed: Fiscal status confirmed for this receipt by the backend.
policy.giftsExcluded: Committee contributions are gifts. They are excluded from business turnover and from every TRA view.
policy.noSurveillance: No social-media surveillance and no automatic tip-off to TRA.
policy.ibmtHoldsNoFunds: IBMT never holds rent. The money passes directly between tenant and landlord; IBMT records it.
policy.noCustodyStage1: IBMT never holds rent. In this stage IBMT only records the payment; the money passes directly between tenant and landlord.
policy.noTaxStage1: No tax is deducted in this stage. Nothing recorded here is tax revenue, and no certificate of tax compliance is issued.
policy.allocationTitle: Allocation of the payment, as provided by the backend
policy.allocationCommission: Eligible agent commission, from the landlord's share
policy.depositCustody: Deposit custody is separate and held in the tenant's name.
policy.tenantPaysExact: The tenant pays rent plus the applicable initial deposit, and nothing else.
policy.noTenantFee: No tenant platform fee, agent fee or viewing fee.
policy.commissionRule: Commission is capped, funded by the landlord, and charged once per new tenancy — never on renewal.
policy.licenceRule: Only council-licensed agents registered as IBMT businesses can be selected on a mandate.
policy.registrationVoluntary: Unit registration is voluntary in Kinondoni and Ubungo. No by-law is in force for this pilot, so no penalty applies and nothing is treated as overdue.
policy.registrationWindow: A registration window is shown only where a confirmed by-law sets one. While the council's mode is voluntary, no window and no penalty applies.
policy.migration: Existing tenancies migrate without forced renegotiation. Paid-through evidence is preserved.
policy.lowRentExemption: The low-rent exemption threshold is defined by TRA in backend policy.
policy.assistedOnboarding: Assisted onboarding is available for operators and landlords.
policy.proxyRegistration: Proxy registration is permitted with evidence of authority.
policy.withholdingDesign: Tax withholding is designed but switched off. No tax is deducted anywhere in this stage, and the machinery stays dormant.
policy.unitCompliance: The compliance entity is the individual unit.
policy.addressMeterPrivate: Each unit links privately to an Anwani ya Makazi address and TANESCO meter evidence.
policy.ownershipVerifiedFirst: A unit cannot receive rent until ownership evidence is verified by the authorised officer.
policy.oneTenancyOneUnit: One tenancy relates to one unit and one active lease.
policy.policyVersioned: Tax rates, stamp duty, commission caps, exemption thresholds, advance-rent limits and response windows are versioned backend policy values. They are displayed from the backend and never hard-coded here.
policy.checklistNotRelease: A completed condition checklist is not deposit release.
policy.humanReviewOnly: An address or meter mismatch, or unusually low rent, creates a human-review notice only. No automatic fine, informant reward, scraping or allegation is created.
policy.consentSeparate: One consent is required to run the service: the unit, lease and rent records for a tenancy, shared with the council and its ward officer. Listing marketing, rent-history credit use and lender sharing are optional, separate and withdrawable.
policy.retentionFromBackend: Retention periods are shown as supplied by the backend. This interface does not state a statutory period.
policy.tenantDetailsLimit: Tenant details are shown to TRA only in the approved backend projection.
policy.committeeNeverTra: Committee records are never exposed to TRA.
policy.addressesNeverPublic: Exact home addresses and GPS coordinates never appear on public pages, public responses, analytics or public document links.
policy.noAutoEnforcement: Nothing here is an enforcement action. Human review comes before any decision.

landing.kicker: IBMT Rent · Kodi ya Nyumba · Tanzania
landing.title: Registered Homes. Registered Agents. Rent Receipts.
landing.titleEn: Registered Homes. Fair Leases. Rent With Receipts.
landing.lede: IBMT Rent is a register of rented homes, leases and rent records for landlords, tenants, licensed agents and councils. The lease exists in writing, and rent is recorded with a receipt that both sides can see.
landing.accessSentEmail: We sent a six-digit code to the email on your account: {to}
landing.accessSentPhone: We sent a six-digit code to the phone number on your account: {to}
landing.accessDemo: The SMS gateway is not connected yet, so the code is shown here for the demo.
landing.accessExpires: The code expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
landing.accessRole: This account is registered as {role}. A code opens only the workspace that belongs to the account.
landing.accessSignIn: Codes go only to the phone number or email on your account. Sign in so we know which account to send yours to.
landing.accessNote: This confirms it is you before the workspace opens. Your own account still decides what you may see inside it.
landing.accessExpired: That code is no longer valid. Request a new one.
landing.accessRate: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
landing.accessNoPhone: No phone number is on your account yet. Use email instead.
landing.accessFailed: The code could not be sent. Try again.
landing.landlordBody: Register your units, keep your tenancies in one place and record the rent you receive. Registration is voluntary at this stage.
landing.tenantBody: Find a registered home, keep your lease, record your rent, and hold the record that shows what you paid.
landing.councilBody: See registered units, verified ownership and licensed agents in your area. Commissioners get read-only figures.
landing.verifyBody: Check a lease, a rent record or an agent licence by its reference. No personal details are needed to check.
landing.verifyLede: Enter a lease, rent-record or agent-licence reference to see what is publicly confirmable.
landing.pilotNote: Pilot: Kinondoni and Ubungo, Dar es Salaam. Registration is voluntary.
landing.forOperatorsBody: Register units, keep tenancies in one place and record the rent you receive.
landing.forCitizensBody: Find a registered home, keep your lease, record your rent, and hold the record that shows what you paid.
landing.forGovernmentBody: Work inside your own council: registered units, verified ownership, licensed agents and read-only figures.
landing.rentBody: A register of rented homes: unit registration, ownership verification, written leases, and rent records with a receipt both sides can see.
landing.rentPilot: Pilot: Kinondoni and Ubungo, Dar es Salaam. Registration is voluntary.
landing.howTitle: What a record journey looks like
landing.step1Body: The business records what was provided and what was paid.
landing.step2Body: Amounts are linked to evidence, and labelled by the quality of that evidence.
landing.step3Body: The customer can confirm the record. A rating follows the record, not a rumour.
landing.step4Body: Where something does not add up, an authorised officer reviews it. Nothing is automatic.
landing.ctaBody: Landlords can register a unit. Tenants can look for a registered home. Anyone can check a record by its reference.
landing.footnote: This is the interface layer of IBMT. Business records, tax policy and payments are owned by the IBMT backend and are not simulated as complete here.

verify.title: Verify a record
verify.lede: Public verification answers one question: is this record real, and what does it confirm?
verify.notFound: No public record matches that reference
verify.notFoundBody: Check the reference. A record may exist but not be public, and unpublished records are never confirmed or denied here.
verify.publicScopeBody: A public check confirms existence, status and the amounts already public on the document you are holding. It never reveals addresses, GPS coordinates or personal details.
verify.privacyNote: Do not enter personal data. A reference alone is enough.
verify.rateLimitNote: Repeated lookups of references you do not hold may be restricted by the backend.

ussd.title: USSD simulator
ussd.simulation: Simulation — demonstration only. No real USSD session runs and no money moves.
ussd.lede: The rent service on a basic phone, without internet or a smartphone.
ussd.note: Simulated keypad with demonstration data. Real USSD responses come from the backend.
ussd.sessionNote: Session state is local to this simulator only.

docs.title: Documents
docs.lede: Documents that parties can preview and download. Final documents are issued by the IBMT backend.
docs.backendNote: Eligibility and the final document come from the backend. This specimen only shows the layout and the bilingual wording.
docs.printHint: Use your browser print dialogue to keep a copy of a specimen.

handover.title: Delivery and handover
handover.lede: What the backend team needs to implement against, and what is still simulated.
handover.enOnly: The delivery package is written in English for the backend team.
handover.boundaryBody: No business database, tax rule, payment flow, licence decision or authoritative audit log exists in this layer. Every business value on screen comes from the integration layer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.platformNote: Your own records, stored and validated by the IBMT platform backend. Offline writes sync automatically.
settings.apiBaseHint: Runtime setting. The backend's approved session mechanism carries authority, not this value.
settings.sessionBody: Identity comes from the IBMT backend. This interface keeps only presentation preferences, and never credentials.
settings.signedOut: Not signed in through IBMT yet

privacy.title: Privacy, access and your data
privacy.lede: What is held about you, who can see it, and how to ask for a copy or a correction.
privacy.whatWeHoldBody: In this interface: your language, theme, data-source mode and demonstration role. Business records are held by the IBMT backend.
privacy.purposeMandatory: Required to run the service: the unit, lease and rent records for a tenancy, shared with the council and its ward officer. No tax is deducted in this stage and no by-law is in force yet.
privacy.purposeMarketing: Optional: publishing a listing for marketing.
privacy.purposeCredit: Optional: using rent history to support credit.
privacy.purposeLender: Optional: sharing with a lender you name.
privacy.withdraw: Withdrawable at any time, separately from the others.
privacy.accessHistoryBody: Who opened your records, and when, as recorded by the backend.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask for a copy of your own records, ask what is held, and ask for a correction. Export requests are handled by the backend and recorded.
privacy.noStatutory: This interface does not state a statutory retention period. Any period shown comes from the backend.

receipt.noArrears: No rent arrears in recent periods.
receipt.smsBody: With SMS on, a reminder is sent as a text message. Otherwise it stays inside the app.

moneyPage.title: Rent and receipts
moneyPage.lede: Enter rent paid, confirm the tenant's records, and issue receipts. This record is not a government tax receipt.
moneyPage.receiptBody: You cannot confirm a record you entered yourself. The receipt is issued when the tenant confirms, and the receipt number is issued at the same time.

leasePublic.noMatch: This number does not match any lease. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
leasePublic.stampBody: Stamp duty on the lease will be confirmed. No amount is charged here.
leasePublic.notOwnershipTitle: This page does not prove ownership
leasePublic.notOwnershipBody: No name, address, house number or meter number is shown here. The page only confirms that a lease with this number is registered in IBMT Rent.

certPublic.title: Check a registration certificate
certPublic.lede: This page confirms that a certificate was issued by IBMT. It does not show the house address or the meter number.
certPublic.noAnswerBody: Verification is not available right now. Try again later.
certPublic.notFoundBody: No approved certificate has this number. A valid certificate is issued only after the Mtaa officer approves the registration.
certPublic.shownBody: Ward, mtaa, district, unit number, date and the owner's name in short. The address, meter and rent are never shown.

certOwn.notVisible: This certificate is not visible to you.
certOwn.onlyAfterApproval: A certificate is issued only after the Mtaa officer approves.
certOwn.scanHint: Scan the QR code to verify the certificate without showing the address.
certOwn.privacy: This certificate shows only the ward and mtaa. The full address, meter number and rent are not shown.

verifyPublic.title: Verify a record
verifyPublic.lede: Check a lease, a receipt, an agent licence or a unit registration. You get the status only: no name, address or phone number.

none.lease: No lease matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
none.receipt: No receipt matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
none.agent: No agent licence matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
none.unit: No unit registration matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.

verifyPublic.rateLimited: Checks are rate-limited to prevent scraping of records.

entry.unknown: This entry does not exist. Choose a way into the rental site.
entry.lede: Enter the confirmation code sent to the phone number or email address on your account. Each code works once only.

agentLicences.title: Agent licences
agentLicences.lede: A broker holds one licence per council. Every decision except approval needs a reason, and it stays in the registration history.
agentLicences.endsMandates: Suspending or revoking ends active mandates
agentLicences.reasonHint: Required to reject, suspend or revoke

listings.title: Unit listings
listings.lede: List a verified unit. The public sees only the ward and mtaa; the address opens after a viewing is booked.
listings.noViewingFee: No viewing fee: the tenant pays TZS 0
listings.verifiedBody: A unit that is not verified cannot be listed.
listings.noneWaiting: No verified unit is waiting to be listed.
listings.addressHidden: the public does not see the address

tax.title: Tax statement (estimate)
tax.lede: Tax estimated from confirmed rent records. This is not a tax assessment or a payment.
tax.noRuleBody: No tax rule has been set yet, so no amount is shown.

migrate.title: Register a current tenant
migrate.lede: The terms stay as they are. The standard lease applies only when this tenancy is renewed.
migrate.addedBody: terms unchanged · no new lease was prepared.
migrate.termsBody: Rent, dates and other terms stay as they are. The standard lease comes only at renewal.
migrate.addressBody: The full address is not shown on the certificate; only the ward and mtaa.

errors.name: Write your full name.
errors.rent: Write the rent you pay each month.
errors.brokerChoice: Choose whether you paid a broker or not.
errors.brokerAmount: Write the amount you paid the broker.

tenantJoin.paidBroker: You wrote that you paid a broker {amount} TZS.
tenantJoin.noBroker: You wrote that you did not pay a broker. This answer is saved in the record.
tenantJoin.whoSees: The landlord and the council see the details you sent. Your NIDA number is not shown publicly.
tenantJoin.declarationTitle: What you send is your own statement
tenantJoin.declarationBody: You wrote these details yourself. A lease signed with the landlord is still needed.
tenantJoin.yourDetailsBody: Fill in your details and what you pay.
tenantJoin.brokerQ: Did you pay a broker when you moved in?
tenantJoin.privacy: Your details go only to the landlord and the council. The NIDA number is not shown publicly.

mandates.title: Agent mandates
mandates.lede: The owner chooses one licensed agent, a commission within the policy cap, and signs with a code.
mandates.licensedOnly: An agent without a licence cannot be chosen
mandates.giveBody: Start by checking the agent's licence.
mandates.noUnits: No unit yet. Register a unit first.
mandates.agentEmailHint: The email they used to register with IBMT
mandates.notLicensedBody: The council has not confirmed a licence for this account. You may not name this agent.
mandates.commissionHint: Paid by the owner. The tenant pays nothing.
mandates.existingBody: An active mandate gives the agent access to that unit.

errors.required: Choose a unit, then write the tenant's name and phone number.
errors.nida: A NIDA number has 20 digits. Make sure you wrote them all.

pangisha.lede: The link for capturing an incoming tenant's details for one unit. No lease is created here.
pangisha.linkBody: Use this link to enter the details of an incoming tenant.
pangisha.stillSigns: The tenant will still sign a lease with the landlord. Here we only record the details and send them a registration notice.
pangisha.tenantBody: Fill in the details of the tenant moving into the unit.
pangisha.nidaHint: 20 digits from the tenant's NIDA card
pangisha.phoneHint: The registration notice is sent to this number
pangisha.notesHint: When the tenant moves in, how many people
pangisha.save: Save and send the tenant a notice
pangisha.sentToPhone: The notice was sent to the tenant's phone.
pangisha.smsNotSentBody: The message is prepared and saved. No SMS service is connected, so nothing has left the system. It will be sent once an SMS service is set up.
pangisha.selfBody: Details they filled in themselves through the link you gave them.
pangisha.recordedBody: Details already entered through this link.

errors.name: Write the broker's name.
errors.phone: A phone number is required. For example 0712345678.

agentDash.lede: Your licence, signed mandates and the commission the owner owes you.
agentDash.ownerPays: Commission is paid by the owner
agentDash.licenceBody: The council decides; every decision has a reason and a date.
agentDash.needLicenceTitle: You cannot be proposed without a licence
agentDash.needLicenceBody: An owner cannot name you in a mandate until your licence in that council is approved.
agentDash.openTitle: You have an application or licence in this district
agentDash.openBody: Each broker holds one licence per council. Choose another district if you want to register there.
agentDash.name: Broker's name
agentDash.emailHint: Optional. If you give it, the council will use it to reach you.
agentDash.nidaHint: 20 digits from the broker's national ID
agentDash.businessHint: If any. A broker can work under their own name.
agentDash.scopeHint: A sales-only registration does not give you a rental mandate
agentDash.mandatoryTitle: Agent registration is required in this council
agentDash.mandatoryBody: The council has decided that every broker must register before working.
agentDash.notesHint: Experience, the area you work in
agentDash.commissionBody: Owed by the owner. The tenant pays nothing.
agentDash.myMandatesBody: A mandate becomes active after the owner signs with a code.
